description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PimCsvDataImportService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the import functionality for employee data CSV files, including handling duplicates and invalid entries.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing import functionalities of PimCsvDataImportService, including handling duplicates, invalid data, and various edge cases.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run, populating essential test data such as countries and nationalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup before each test, truncating specific tables and instantiating the data import service.

methods.name: testGetCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Verifies that the PimCsvDataImportService provides an instance of CsvDataImportService.

methods.name: testImport
methods.description: Tests successful CSV data import with valid data.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests handling of duplicate employee IDs during import.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Tests import behavior with invalid or missing first and last names.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid license expiry date formats.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidMaritalStatus
methods.description: Checks the import process's response to invalid marital status entries.

methods.name: testImportWithNationality
methods.description: Verifies importing data with nationality values, including invalid entries.

methods.name: testImportWithContactDetails
methods.description: Tests the handling of contact details in the CSV import, including missing and duplicate emails.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMailForSameEmployee
methods.description: Tests duplicate email addresses associated with the same employee.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMail
methods.description: Tests duplicate email addresses across different employees.

methods.name: testImportWithoutFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Tests import behavior when essential fields like first and last names are missing.
